threadDescriptions.survey-practice: Improve traverse-adjustment skills for the surveying professional exam.
threadDescriptions.survey-booking: Complete exam registration and required access arrangements.
threadDescriptions.study-circle: Organize peer study sessions and a shared question bank.
threadDescriptions.dental-visit: Arrange and attend a routine dental appointment.

items.text: Traverse practice plan: work six closed-loop questions this week, then redo any closure errors without looking at the worked answers.
Surveying exam portal: registration incomplete until photo ID and access-arrangement form are uploaded. Deadline the 14th.
Dental receptionist offered the 14th at 09:00 for check-up. Ask whether that includes cleaning.
items.rationale: Arranges unrelated dental visit with overlapping date.

items.text: Study circle: Mei and Rowan can meet Wednesdays. Reserve the quiet room and give everyone two questions to contribute.
Loop exercise 4: I keep applying the eastings correction to the northings column. Circle the column labels before calculating.
Exam access form sent with evidence. Portal still says pending; save the confirmation number and check Friday.
Wednesday room booking needs a group name. Use 'Survey circle' and book ninety minutes, no projector.
'14, bring the form' on a sticky note without letterhead.
items.rationale: Date and form reference do not resolve the appointment or registration.

items.text: Correction to my traverse formula card: distribute angular misclosure evenly across angles here, not proportional to line length. My previous card mixed two different adjustment steps.
items.rationale: Corrects a specific previously used study method.

items.text: Dentist confirmed the 14th appointment includes cleaning. Appointment card says arrive ten minutes early for updated history form.
Rowan's proposed study questions duplicate Mei's. Keep Mei's two and ask Rowan for instrument-error problems before Wednesday.

Bring my corrected angular-misclosure card to the Survey circle and run a ten-minute worked example. Add the six traverse questions I practised to the shared bank, with the eastings/northings mistake highlighted in the answer notes.
items.rationale: Uses personal practice findings and concretely updates group session and bank.

items.text: Exam centre approved a low-distraction seat. Registration is complete once I pay the remaining fee by Monday.
items.rationale: Updates exam registration status and next step.

items.text: Timed traverse attempt: 42 minutes, closure within tolerance. Still wasted five minutes copying coordinates twice.
Quiet-room staff moved our Survey circle to upstairs room 2 for this Wednesday only. Send the room number with the question sheet.
Portal receipt: exam fee paid, low-distraction seat noted, candidate entry saved offline.
Too early. move to next week?
Dental visit done. Next routine check-up card filed; buy the smaller brush heads recommended during cleaning.
I redid loop exercise 4 from blank paper. No swapped columns this time; annotate the old wrong solution rather than deleting it.
items.rationale: Tracks improvement and preserves earlier practice provenance.

items.text: Survey circle attendance five. The short worked example fit; leave more time for everyone's instrument-error answers next meeting.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: date 14 and an unnamed form also fit the dental visit, so the source remains uncertain.
